The middle row of the kernels for wavelength 4, angle 0, sigma 1 and aspect ratio 1. The kernels are 7 x 7, because the window ends at 3 sigma. On this row y = 0, so x' = x and y' = 0. Each weight is the envelope exp(-x^2 / 2) / (2 pi) times the cosine or the sine. The real kernel is even and finds thin lines. The imaginary kernel is odd and finds edges.
